# Switch NX2 - read when the Eglantine GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eglantine\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eglantine/nx2_switches.txt; in a portable build user\nx2_switches.txt, or
# user/config/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Every line below is off: with no switch set the emulator runs on the baseline settings, which
# are the settings every game is tested on (fork-notes/baseline.md). A switch you add is a deviation
# from the baseline. Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Switches that are already on by default; listed only to turn them off ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread. On by default; 0 turns it off.
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=0

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes. On by default;
# 0 releases one fence at a time.
#EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=0

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) also copies back
# buffers the CPU never touches, which adds mutex contention. Its effect on speed is not measured
# in this fork.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Speed experiments (0.4) ---
# Off by default. Its 0.4 measurement is being repeated. Read once when it is first needed. Values: 1
# turns it on; unset or any other value leaves it off.

# Windows only, multicore CPU emulation. The host timer thread (it delivers the guest's timed events,
# vsync among them) waits on a high resolution waitable timer instead of a wait that follows the
# Windows timer resolution. Windows 10 1803 or later.
#EDEN_NX2_HIRES_TIMER=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in). Its effect on speed is not
# measured in this fork.
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

# EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH is kept from upstream's file; this fork's source does not read it.
#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- Test switches (for unattended-run tests; never set these in normal use) ---
# Crash the emulator on purpose after N presented frames (a null write on the thread that presents).
# Used to test that a crash during a scripted run (eden-cli --report ...) leaves a report with
# exit.reason "host_crash" and the process exit code 73. Off unless set.
#EDEN_NX2_TEST_CRASH_AFTER_FRAMES=300
